papers.title: How climatic, edaphic, and biotic drivers collectively govern large-scale grassland biomass allocation
papers.recommendationReason: 重点体现导师方向与应用价值；命中“belowground、carbon sequestration、management、mechanism”等信号。

essence.problem: Abstract The pattern of vegetation biomass allocation is a key mechanism for understanding the carbon sequestration function of grassland ecosystems and their responses to global change.
essence.design: By integrating multi-scale observations and global datasets, this study applied extreme gradient boosting (XGBoost) and used SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP) to quantify variable importance and partial dependence across environmental gradients, revealing how climatic, edaphic, and biological factors synergistically regulate large-scale grassland biomass allocation, and produced a global dataset at 0.

papers.title: Elevation structures plant growth and defence but not resistance to slug herbivory
papers.recommendationReason: 重点体现前沿突破；命中“resistance、trait-based”等信号。

essence.problem: Abstract Predicting how plant resistance to herbivory varies along environmental gradients is a central goal in ecology, yet most empirical tests rely on insect herbivores and may not generalize across consumer guilds.
essence.design: We conducted a common garden experiment using six closely related Brassicaceae species spanning approximately 2,000 m of elevational distribution in the Swiss Alps.
essence.innovation: Rather than elevation per se, species-level trait variation, particularly growth strategies, emerged as a key determinant of herbivory outcomes, highlighting the importance of herbivore functional identity in trait-based frameworks.
essence.limitations: 以上内容基于公开摘要；样本范围、统计细节与因果边界需阅读全文核验。
